plugins.name: business-wiki
plugins.description: Wiki-as-source-of-truth for business rules, with a page index and link graph for cheap navigation, derived rules JSON and OpenAPI, and keeper agents that regenerate them and detect drift. One re-runnable command sets it up, updates it, and repairs it.

plugins.name: sdd-tdd-loop
plugins.description: Local task -> spec -> enumerated use cases -> red/green/refactor, one test per use case. Language-agnostic: /sdd-init writes this repo's test-seam profile and language skill. /sdd-commit and /sdd-pr draft a Conventional Commit and keep a draft PR true to the track.
